clips.title: The story
paras: Off the Wetlands coast, the Menethil Statuette lies lost from a shipwreck. The rare silver likeness honors Lordaeron's fallen king.

King Terenas Menethil II appears in his youth, a long-haired paladin lifting a hammer toward the heavens. He was humble and disliked personal monuments, so few statues or likenesses were made in his honor. The Scourge's fall of Lordaeron destroyed almost all of them. This surviving effigy is extraordinarily valuable to the Alliance.

The Blind Princess carried the statuette toward the Alliance harbor of Menethil. Bluegill murlocs attacked the merchant vessel off the marshy coast, scattering its cargo. The statuette became trapped in a half-buried barrel on shore. With Dragonmaw orcs and other local threats nearby, defenders hurried to send the recovered icon south to Stormwind City. There, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon entrusted it to the Cathedral of Light.
